body.message:
The rate we shared with you is our best available offer, and unfortunately, we are unable to reduce it further.

If you would like to pay by cash tomorrow, you are welcome to visit our main office.

Please note that if you would like to view the apartment before booking, we kindly ask you to contact us again on 10th July.

As the apartment is listed on multiple booking platforms, availability may change. If the unit is still available on that date, we will be happy to arrange a viewing for you accordingly.
